script_snippet:
"""I did everything right,"" she whispered to the empty room. ""So why am I the one still waiting?""

If you have ever turned fifty with no ring on your hand, and lain awake wondering if God simply forgot to write your name in the book where He wrote everybody else's, then stay with Ellen to the very end.

And it started with a wedding she did not want to go to.

Ellen was forty-nine years old, and she liked to say she had waited well.

That was her word for it. Waiting. She said it the way other women said they had raised good children or built a good business.
